event_invariants: Sample age derives from retained timestamps and custody; a new aliquot is not a new polymer batch.
Cure/coating/patterning receipts are external-service evidence, never self-certified success.
Every droplet binds one material/film/spot and exact measured environment history.
Macro volume-based t0, physical dispensing t0 and microscopy scan times remain distinct.
Raw z coordinates, inferred/interpolated z coordinates and reconstructed unloaded positions have different evidence kinds.
Manual edits append provenance and preserve untouched raw images.
Model-predicted tractions/surface tensions remain model output linked to inputs, not sensor output.
Repeated frames/timepoints cannot increase independent droplet/sample counts.
Calibration expiry, changed mount, sample reassignment or parameter changes invalidate dependent receipts.
Failure, exclusion and retry records remain visible; no overwriting failed run with its replacement.
Source numerical outcomes and synthetic fixtures can never satisfy an observed-experiment gate.

measurement_units.length: SI metre canonical, preserve native mm/um fields with explicit scale
measurement_units.volume: SI cubic metre canonical, preserve native nL
measurement_units.pressure_or_stress: Pa with Cauchy/Piola-Kirchhoff and normalization field
measurement_units.angle: radian canonical plus original degrees where recorded
measurement_units.time: s monotonic acquisition plus UTC custody stamps
measurement_units.angular_frequency: rad/s; never silently reinterpret SIomega axis asHz

nullable_policy: Use explicit not_applicable with scoped reason for nonphysical metadata; missing required fields is never inferred
synthetic_authentication: Fixture registry pinned independently by evaluator; not cryptographic production proof
